evidence.finding: The FAQ limits delivery to listed neighborhoods in Belgrade and Pančevo.
The FAQ separately lists delivery neighborhoods in Novi Sad.
The FAQ separately lists delivery neighborhoods in Niš and states a Niš minimum order and delivery fee.

conclusion: The online fulfillment scope published by Maxi is city/neighborhood-limited. The eight feed items point to online product pages, so their city-scoped prices cannot be represented as verified countrywide Product Highlights. This is a scope correction, not proof that any discount expired.
